note: The hardest match: LEFT, the only column whose name derives 1.5.left's suffix, is given to 1.5.kon by an [[identity.column_owner]], so 1.5.left can own nothing and is stale, located at its pin. LEFT is delivered in 2022 so that kon holds one column per year. Without this step the compile could count a column-owned literal as a match for another split and mint an ambiguity with no unresolved row behind it, the shape the old source-scope refusal caught.
fails_if: `_partition_ambiguity` (curation_compile.py) counts a column whose every delivered row a column owner gives to a split as a candidate for another split's suffix, so 1.5.left is no longer reported stale

sources.description: Variable 5 delivers Kon in 2020 (CVID 20), KON in 2021 (CVID 21) and LEFT in 2022 (CVID 22).
